title: Enterprise Connectivity: commitment forgiveness permission
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following commitment forgiveness permission for each named contract tier. Whether customer termination forgives an unexpired signed commitment; boolean.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | commitment forgiveness permission | not permitted |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | commitment forgiveness permission | not permitted |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | commitment forgiveness permission | not permitted |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | commitment forgiveness permission | not permitted |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | commitment forgiveness permission | not permitted |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | commitment forgiveness permission | not permitted |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the commitment forgiveness permission is not permitted.
